attempts.why: The initial smoke process had imported a different DeepGEMM namespace before candidate setup, so it was rejected before correctness or timing.
attempts.resolution: Candidate prepare_process now selects and verifies the content-addressed package before SGLang or DeepGEMM imports.

attempts.why: Runtime flags omitted ptxas verbose, produced a different JIT key, and changed the sealed cache during warmup.
attempts.resolution: The candidate exports DG_JIT_PTXAS_VERBOSE=1 and verifies an unchanged warmed cache.

attempts.why: The unmodified BM16 epilogue used a full-tile TMA store and overwrote invalid caller-owned slab rows for partial tiles.
attempts.resolution: Rejected before fair timing; moved to focused masked-epilogue work.

attempts.why: Reading and restaging invalid BF16 rows preserved ownership but added enough work to lose badly.
Predicated 32-bit global stores removed padded writes and passed correctness, but the selected API-v1 path remained slower than stock.
A 16-byte valid-row store preserved tails and reduced store instructions, but per-call Python counter snapshots obscured the device-kernel gain.
Deferring counter dictionary materialization improved the selected path, but every estimator in every series remained below the required threshold.

routes_not_expanded.why: The auto-stage BM16 candidate failed the first required lane, so an adjacent stage experiment had no retained profile justification.
No surviving end-to-end candidate justified barrier, TMA, or scheduler surgery.
A replacement GEMM was not justified after the focused same-source epilogue candidate failed the API-v1 gate.
Final SASS showed no concrete defect whose repair could plausibly recover the measured end-to-end gap.

nsys.why: Promotion stopped at the first mandatory performance lane.

ncu.why: There was no concrete survivor question.

terminal.why: The first required expected-M 4 eager leaf fairness lane failed.
